body_text:
DOING LESS IS PART OF THE PLAN.
YOU DO NOT NEED TO WIN TODAY.
source_video_prompt: Vertical 9:16 smooth stabilized tracking shot on a quiet gravel park loop under flat overcast morning light. Use the same male runner identity as the previous approved Coachi organic clip: age 25-35, lean endurance-athlete build, short dark slightly textured hair, same skin tone and overall color/complexion continuity as the prior clip, grounded performance styling, alone outdoors. Keep the framing no-face and never reveal a clean front-facing face. This must be one single unbroken clip and one continuous recovery run from start to finish, not multiple beats or stitched moments. Keep one stable relaxed stride pattern the whole time. The camera must not stay static behind him: start in a rear three-quarter medium shot from behind-left, then let the camera itself glide slowly and smoothly around him into a cleaner side-rear tracking angle while the runner keeps the same straight forward jogging line. The movement should feel like slow controlled floating footage, almost lightly drone-like, but still grounded and believable rather than aerial or dramatic. Keep the route, trees, and path readable with natural depth of field and documentary-style focus instead of a smeared background. The only action is a calm steady recovery jog with natural alternating arm swing, relaxed hands, loose shoulders, neutral head position, eyes forward on the path, and consistent cadence from the first second to the last. Do not make him glance sideways, turn left, or rotate his torso to sell the angle change. Keep the body language unforced and human, like someone intentionally holding back on an easy day. Let the weather feel cool through the flat light, muted air, and clothing only; do not make breath vapor the visual focus. Premium but grounded realism, natural easy effort, subtle stabilized motion, believable recovery-day body language, no logos, no text burned into footage, no extra people, no gym, no influencer posing, no whip pans, no scene cuts, no walking transition, no stutter step, no double-step, no stride reset, no tempo shift, no gait break, no cadence glitch, no footfall duplication.
source_video_negative_prompt: watch glance, watch interaction, wrist check, sideways head turn, looking left, glance left, torso twist, shoulder twist, fast orbit, aggressive circling, overhead drone shot, aerial top-down shot, two-hand gesture, both hands raised, visible breath vapor, mouth steam cloud, exaggerated condensation, duplicated footfall, cadence glitch, stride reset, foot morphing, extra limbs, warped arms, broken watch geometry, heavy background blur, creamy bokeh, smeared trees, unreal shallow depth of field
variant_goal: Create a recovery-day recognition clip that feels more dynamic than the previous static trailing shots by using one continuous moving camera path while keeping the same no-face runner continuity.
comment_bait_text: What is harder for you: going hard or holding back?
